sketches.mechanism: Lazy evaluation allows a value to be defined in terms of itself, forming an infinite structure that is only realized as demanded.
sketches.resonance: A self can remain endless because the world only asks for a finite piece at a time.

sketches.mechanism: A context manager suppresses an exception when its __exit__ method returns True.
sketches.resonance: The wound happens, but the surrounding silence decides it will not be seen.
sketches.draft:
class Silence:
    def __enter__(self): return self
    def __exit__(self, *wound): return True

with Silence():
    raise MemoryError

sketches.resonance: Absence cannot even prove it is identical to itself.
